title: Pocketwire Advance Terms — Card Repayments on Past-Due Lines
content:
On a Pocketwire Advance line that is past due, a manual repayment from an external debit card, on tiers that accept manual repayment from an external debit card, takes at most the card repayment share of what the line owes on one day; a customer who asks to pay as much as possible by card repays exactly that amount.

Any other manual repayment, from the personal balance or on a line that is not past due, is at least the tier's smallest manual repayment or the whole amount outstanding on that advance, and never more than that amount.

## Standing conditions

The card repayment share is not applied until the line carries a late fee entry for every late-fee period that has closed on its past-due advance. While any closed late-fee period of that advance is without its late fee entry, the card repayment share is not yet applied.

## Manual repayments at a glance

| Line | Source of the repayment | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Past due | External debit card, on a tier that accepts it | At most the card repayment share of what the line owes on one day; exactly that amount when the customer asks to pay as much as possible by card |
| Past due | Personal balance | At least the smallest manual repayment or the whole amount outstanding on that advance, never more than that amount |
| Not past due | Personal balance or external debit card | At least the smallest manual repayment or the whole amount outstanding on that advance, never more than that amount |

## Making the card repayment: `repay_advance_by_card_db2e846d`

**Capability.** The customer makes a manual repayment on one advance of their Pocketwire Advance line from their external debit card, for the amount given, dated today. The repayment is recorded against that advance and the amount the customer owes on the line goes down by the amount repaid. The customer sees the repayment and the lower amount owed in the app at once. The tool does not check eligibility or timing and does not compute the amount it is handed.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool`, which hands it to the customer, and the customer themselves runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`, using the tool name `repay_advance_by_card_db2e846d` and the argument values the agent gives.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `advance_line_id` | The reference number of the customer's advance line, as returned by the advance line lookup (`find_advance_lines`) | Identifier |
| `source_txn_id` | The reference number of the advance being repaid — its disbursement entry — as returned by the advance activity lookup for that line (`find_advance_ledger`) | Identifier |
| `amount` | The repayment in USD | 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent before it is passed; taken from the card and stored exactly as given |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary confirming the repayment: `repayment_entry_id` (reference number of the new repayment entry), `advance_line_id` (the line), `advance_entry_id` (the advance repaid), `repayment_method` (always `manual_debit_card`), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and `outstanding_balance` (USD, 2 decimal places, what the customer owes on the line afterwards). A returned `repayment_entry_id` means the repayment is recorded.
